data.title: Keyset paging
data.body:
## Keyset paging

Order by `@id` and pass the **last id** of a page as `$after`:

- no `offset`, so a page costs the same at any depth
- a row written behind the cursor is not seen twice

See [spec 004](https://github.com/ModernRelay/omnigraph-studio) for the reads.
